Requested: Approve Cardano Foundation as New Managing Entity of Project Catalyst
Stated amount: not stated in document

Deliverables: The Cardano Foundation (CF), supported by Input Output Group (IOG), is requesting community approval to be appointed as the new managing entity for Project Catalyst., This will allow for full and effective transition of Catalyst operations and responsibilities from IOG to CF in accordance with the statutes of the Catalyst Foundation Company (CFC)., This transition will ensure continuity of operations and minimise delays on milestone reviews and eligible payouts for teams delivering against projects in Funds 10-14., This approval request and Info Action is unrelated to Intersect’s role as the constitutionally mandated budget administrator for funds 14 to 16.
